description: User can upload a completed form as PDF
System records the upload date and the user who uploaded the form
System calculates the due date for each form type
System flags forms that are within 3 days of their due date
System marks forms past their due date as overdue
Supervisor can view all overdue forms on one screen
User can search forms by form type and date range
System keeps an audit log of every view and edit
Uploaded forms are retained for the configured retention period
Error message appears when an upload is not a PDF
